# dsh-table-copy
Hover toolbar for every Markdown table in DeepSeek Harness Web — copy the table as **Markdown** or a
s a **PNG image**, straight into the system clipboard.
Light theme:
Dark theme:
Paste the image into WeChat, Feishu, a doc or an issue: it is snapped at 2× with the current theme's
background, fonts and borders.
Everything is client-side: no network calls, no filesystem access, no extra host routes. The only th
ing it touches is the clipboard.

## Usage

1. Move the pointer over any Markdown table — a two-button pill fades in at its top-right corner.
2.
**Left button (image)** — the table goes to the clipboard as a PNG. If the browser refuses image wr

ites, the same PNG is downloaded instead.
3. **Right button (copy)** — the table goes to the clipboa
rd as Markdown (`| a | b |` plus a `| --- |` separator row). The button flashes a check mark and a s
hort toast confirms.
The toolbar stays out of the way otherwise: it only appears on hover.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) only declares the plugin identity. No routes, no services.
- **Brow
ser half** (`lib/client.js`) installs a `MutationObserver`, finds every `<table>` inside the Markdow

n container, and appends a `<caption class="dtc-tools">` to it.
- The table node itself is never wra
pped or moved: that tree belongs to React, and an extra wrapper gets torn out on the next streaming
re-render. A `<caption>` is the table's own child, so it is simply re-added when the renderer rebuil

ds the table.
- Caption and pill both use `position: sticky; right: 0`, so the buttons stay pinned t

o the visible right edge while a wide table scrolls horizontally.
- Markdown export reads `table.row

s`, collapses whitespace per cell and escapes `|`.
- Image export clones the table, inlines the comp
uted styles of every node (a 48-property whitelist), wraps the clone in a `foreignObject` SVG, loads

it as an image, paints it onto a 2× canvas and calls `canvas.toBlob("image/png")`.
- The background
is taken from the first opaque ancestor, so dark-theme tables export dark instead of white.
## Known limits
- The SVG must travel as a `data:` URL. A `blob:` URL taints the canvas in Chromium and `toBlob()` t

hrows `SecurityError`.
- The image is a snapshot of the **rendered** width: columns scrolled out of
view are still captured, because the cloned table keeps its `width: max-content` layout at full size

.
- Links inside the table keep their colour and text but are not clickable in the PNG.
- Only Markd
own-rendered tables are decorated; product UI tables (settings, plugin lists) are left alone.
